description.value: A 76-site rainforest campground on a golf-course property midway between Tofino and Ucluelet, a 2-minute drive or 30-minute walk to Long Beach in Pacific Rim National Park; flush toilets and free showers on-site, but tent rates are steep at $55–$70/night.

address.value: 1850 Pacific Rim Hwy, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content from longbeachgolfcourse.com/camp-ground fully corroborates the OSM tags: drinking_water=yes is confirmed ('There is running drinking water throughout the campground'), shower=yes is confirmed ('flush toilets, urinals, & Free Showers' on main page; FAQ states 'We have free showers that are available for Long Beach Campground campers'), and tents=yes/caravans=yes are confirmed (76 tent campsites and 6 full-service RV sites described). The website further reveals Tacofino as an on-site dining option and an active online reservation system, and the contact page provides a campground-specific phone absent from OSM. No evidence of hiker/biker-specific sites, laundry, device charging, or bike-service amenities was found, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM lists no phone number; campground-specific phone (250) 725-3314 sourced from website contact page.
Campground gate is locked 11pm–6am; late-arriving cyclists must park outside and walk in — operationally relevant for touring logistics.
OSM community field lists 'Esowista' while the website mailing address uses 'Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0'; these are adjacent locales and not a material discrepancy, but worth noting for address validation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground with tent sites, potable water, free showers, and on-site food in a prime cycling corridor between Tofino and Ucluelet near Pacific Rim National Park — a clear and well-evidenced benefit for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: flush toilets and free showers on-site
